record.field: Analyze the fuel consumption history for this vehicle. Calculate average fuel efficiency (km/l or mpg), identify any sudden changes in consumption, compare against manufacturer specifications, and provide recommendations to improve fuel efficiency.

Based on the job cards and work orders, analyze technician productivity. Calculate jobs completed per day, average time per job type, identify the most efficient technicians, and suggest training or resource improvements.

Analyze the spare parts consumption data. Identify fast-moving and slow-moving parts, calculate reorder points based on consumption frequency, flag items below minimum stock levels, and suggest optimal reorder quantities to minimize stockouts and overstocking.
